summary: OWNH covers fewer than ten repositories, dozens of owners and tens of thousands of lines. Ownership is concentrated: [O1] holds 54.2% of lines, while inactive owners account for 76.1% at [T0], a majority since [T-10].
Blank lines represent 20.5% of lines and are attributed to [O1]. The next blank-line milestone is projected for [T+22]; the line-survival half-life is 2 years and is not projected.

Cross-repository ownership is uneven: 80% of [R1]’s lines were written elsewhere, while 57% of [R3]’s lines are owned by non-contributors. The methods agree in no repositories, limiting confidence in attribution consistency.

okr.objective: Build a more balanced and consistent ownership profile across repositories.

keyResults.text: Reduce principal-owner concentration from 54.1% at [T0], after it rose from 51.2% at [T-3].
Lower the inactive-owner share from 76.1% at [T0], after easing from 77.9% at [T-3], while the majority has persisted since [T-10].
Increase method agreement from a baseline of no repositories.
